description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kadawadduwa, Devinuwara D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. (24/1012)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring title determinations for multiple land parcels in the Village of Kadawadduwa. The document contains detailed schedules of land parcels, ownership details, extents, and encumbrances, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
